rootCause.summary: The cordis preset registered its own skills/ directory as a skill root. A packaged preset lives inside app.asar, where the DSH filesystem service cannot list a directory: fs-local probes with stat({ bigint: true }) and Electron's asar stat ignores that option, so `info.mode & 0o777n` throws 'Cannot mix BigInt and other types'. skill-registry skips the whole provider and neither bundled skill reaches the catalog.
